182: static const char *skip_shebang(const char *p) {
183:   if (strncmp(p, "#!", sizeof("#!") - 1) != 0)
184:     return p;
185:   const char *n = strchr(p, '\n');
186:   if (n == NULL || n[1] != '#')
187:     return p;
188:   n = strchr(n + 1, '\n');
189:   if (n == NULL || n[1] == '#' || n[1] == '\0' || n[-1] != '\\' || n[-2] == '\\')
190:     return p;
191:   n = strchr(n + 1, '\n');
192:   if (n == NULL)
193:     return p;
194:   return n+1;
195: }

197: static int process(jq_state *jq, jv value, int flags, int dumpopts, int options) {
198:   int ret = JQ_OK_NO_OUTPUT; // No valid results && -e -> exit(4)
199:   jq_start(jq, value, flags);
200:   jv result;
201:   while (jv_is_valid(result = jq_next(jq))) {
202:     if ((options & RAW_OUTPUT) && jv_get_kind(result) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
203:       if (options & ASCII_OUTPUT) {
204:         jv_dumpf(jv_copy(result), stdout, JV_PRINT_ASCII);
205:       } else if ((options & RAW_OUTPUT0) && strlen(jv_string_value(result)) != (unsigned long)jv_string_length_bytes(jv_copy(result))) {
206:         jv_free(result);
207:         result = jv_invalid_with_msg(jv_string(
208:               "Cannot dump a string containing NUL with --raw-output0 option"));
209:         break;
210:       } else {
211:         priv_fwrite(jv_string_value(result), jv_string_length_bytes(jv_copy(result)),
212:             stdout, dumpopts & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
213:       }
214:       ret = JQ_OK;
215:       jv_free(result);
216:     } else {
217:       if (jv_get_kind(result) == JV_KIND_FALSE || jv_get_kind(result) == JV_KIND_NULL)
218:         ret = JQ_OK_NULL_KIND;
219:       else
220:         ret = JQ_OK;
221:       if (options & SEQ)
222:         priv_fwrite("\036", 1, stdout, dumpopts & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
223:       jv_dump(result, dumpopts);
224:     }
225:     if (!(options & RAW_NO_LF))
226:       priv_fwrite("\n", 1, stdout, dumpopts & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
227:     if (options & RAW_OUTPUT0)
228:       priv_fwrite("\0", 1, stdout, dumpopts & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
229:     if (options & UNBUFFERED_OUTPUT)
230:       fflush(stdout);
231:   }
232:   if (jq_halted(jq)) {
233:     // jq program invoked `halt` or `halt_error`
234:     jv exit_code = jq_get_exit_code(jq);
235:     if (!jv_is_valid(exit_code))
236:       ret = JQ_OK;
237:     else if (jv_get_kind(exit_code) == JV_KIND_NUMBER)
238:       ret = jv_number_value(exit_code);
239:     else
240:       ret = JQ_ERROR_UNKNOWN;
241:     jv_free(exit_code);
242:     jv error_message = jq_get_error_message(jq);
243:     if (jv_get_kind(error_message) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
244:       // No prefix should be added to the output of `halt_error`.
245:       priv_fwrite(jv_string_value(error_message), jv_string_length_bytes(jv_copy(error_message)),
246:           stderr, dumpopts & JV_PRINT_ISATTY);
247:     } else if (jv_get_kind(error_message) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
248:       // Halt with no output
249:     } else if (jv_is_valid(error_message)) {
250:       error_message = jv_dump_string(error_message, 0);
251:       fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", jv_string_value(error_message));
252:     } // else no message on stderr; use --debug-trace to see a message
253:     fflush(stderr);
254:     jv_free(error_message);
255:   } else if (jv_invalid_has_msg(jv_copy(result))) {
256:     // Uncaught jq exception
257:     jv msg = jv_invalid_get_msg(jv_copy(result));
258:     jv input_pos = jq_util_input_get_position(jq);
259:     if (jv_get_kind(msg) == JV_KIND_STRING) {
260:       fprintf(stderr, "jq: error (at %s): %s\n",
261:               jv_string_value(input_pos), jv_string_value(msg));
262:     } else {
263:       msg = jv_dump_string(msg, 0);
264:       fprintf(stderr, "jq: error (at %s) (not a string): %s\n",
265:               jv_string_value(input_pos), jv_string_value(msg));
266:     }
267:     ret = JQ_ERROR_UNKNOWN;
268:     jv_free(input_pos);
269:     jv_free(msg);
270:   }
271:   jv_free(result);
272:   return ret;
273: }

297: static int jq_cli_session_consume_argv(struct jq_cli_session *session,
298:                                        struct jq_cli_arg_mode *mode,
299:                                        jq_util_input_state *input,
300:                                        struct jq_cli_compile_opts *compile_opts,
301:                                        struct jq_cli_lib_search *lib_search,
302:                                        struct jq_cli_parser_opts *parser_opts,
303:                                        int argc, char **argv,
304:                                        int *options, int *dumpopts, int *jq_flags,
305:                                        jv *ARGS, jv *program_arguments,
306:                                        jv *lib_search_paths, int *ret) {
307:   size_t short_opts = 0;
308:   for (int i=1; i<argc; i++, short_opts = 0) {
309:     if (mode->args_done) {
310:       if (mode->further_args_are_strings) {
311:         *ARGS = jv_array_append(*ARGS, jv_string(argv[i]));
312:       } else if (mode->further_args_are_json) {
313:         jv v =  jv_parse(argv[i]);
314:         if (!jv_is_valid(v)) {
315:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: invalid JSON text passed to --jsonargs\n", progname);
316:           die();
317:         }
318:         *ARGS = jv_array_append(*ARGS, v);
319:       } else {
320:         jq_util_input_add_input(input, argv[i]);
321:         session->nfiles = jq_util_input_nfiles(input);
322:       }
323:     } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--")) {
324:       if (!mode->program) usage(2, 1);
325:       mode->args_done = 1;
326:     } else if (!isoptish(argv[i])) {
327:       if (mode->program) {
328:         if (mode->further_args_are_strings) {
329:           *ARGS = jv_array_append(*ARGS, jv_string(argv[i]));
330:         } else if (mode->further_args_are_json) {
331:           jv v =  jv_parse(argv[i]);
332:           if (!jv_is_valid(v)) {
333:             fprintf(stderr, "%s: invalid JSON text passed to --jsonargs\n", progname);
334:             die();
335:           }
336:           *ARGS = jv_array_append(*ARGS, v);
337:         } else {
338:           jq_util_input_add_input(input, argv[i]);
339:           session->nfiles = jq_util_input_nfiles(input);
340:         }
341:       } else {
342:         mode->program = argv[i];
343:       }
344:     } else {
345:       if (argv[i][1] == 'L') {
346:         if (!lib_search->user_specified || lib_search->path_count == 0)
347:           *lib_search_paths = jv_array();
348:         lib_search->user_specified = 1;
349:         lib_search->path_count++;
350:         if (argv[i][2] != 0) { // -Lname (faster check than strlen)
351:             *lib_search_paths = jv_array_append(*lib_search_paths, jq_realpath(jv_string(argv[i]+2)));
352:         } else if (i >= argc - 1) {
353:           fprintf(stderr, "-L takes a parameter: (e.g. -L /search/path or -L/search/path)\n");
354:           die();
355:         } else {
356:           *lib_search_paths = jv_array_append(*lib_search_paths, jq_realpath(jv_string(argv[i+1])));
357:           i++;
358:         }
359:         continue;
360:       }
361: 
362:       if (isoption(argv[i], 's', "slurp", &short_opts)) {
363:         *options |= SLURP;
364:         if (!short_opts) continue;
365:       }
366:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'r', "raw-output", &short_opts)) {
367:         *options |= RAW_OUTPUT;
368:         if (!short_opts) continue;
369:       }
370:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "raw-output0", &short_opts)) {
371:         *options |= RAW_OUTPUT | RAW_NO_LF | RAW_OUTPUT0;
372:         if (!short_opts) continue;
373:       }
374:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'j', "join-output", &short_opts)) {
375:         *options |= RAW_OUTPUT | RAW_NO_LF;
376:         if (!short_opts) continue;
377:       }
378:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'c', "compact-output", &short_opts)) {
379:         *dumpopts &= ~(JV_PRINT_TAB | JV_PRINT_INDENT_FLAGS(7));
380:         if (!short_opts) continue;
381:       }
382:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'C', "color-output", &short_opts)) {
383:         *options |= COLOR_OUTPUT;
384:         if (!short_opts) continue;
385:       }
386:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'M', "monochrome-output", &short_opts)) {
387:         *options |= NO_COLOR_OUTPUT;
388:         if (!short_opts) continue;
389:       }
390:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'a', "ascii-output", &short_opts)) {
391:         *options |= ASCII_OUTPUT;
392:         if (!short_opts) continue;
393:       }
394:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "unbuffered", &short_opts)) {
395:         *options |= UNBUFFERED_OUTPUT;
396:         continue;
397:       }
398:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'S', "sort-keys", &short_opts)) {
399:         *options |= SORTED_OUTPUT;
400:         if (!short_opts) continue;
401:       }
402:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'R', "raw-input", &short_opts)) {
403:         parser_opts->raw_input = 1;
404:         *options |= RAW_INPUT;
405:         if (!short_opts) continue;
406:       }
407:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'n', "null-input", &short_opts)) {
408:         *options |= PROVIDE_NULL;
409:         if (!short_opts) continue;
410:       }
411:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'f', "from-file", &short_opts)) {
412:         compile_opts->from_file = 1;
413:         *options |= FROM_FILE;
414:         if (!short_opts) continue;
415:       }
416:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'b', "binary", &short_opts)) {
417: #ifdef WIN32
418:         fflush(stdout);
419:         fflush(stderr);
420:         _setmode(fileno(stdin),  _O_BINARY);
421:         _setmode(fileno(stdout), _O_BINARY);
422:         _setmode(fileno(stderr), _O_BINARY);
423:         if (!short_opts) continue;
424: #endif
425:       }
426:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "tab", &short_opts)) {
427:         *dumpopts &= ~JV_PRINT_INDENT_FLAGS(7);
428:         *dumpopts |= JV_PRINT_TAB | JV_PRINT_PRETTY;
429:         continue;
430:       }
431:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "indent", &short_opts)) {
432:         if (i >= argc - 1) {
433:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: --indent takes one parameter\n", progname);
434:           die();
435:         }
436:         *dumpopts &= ~(JV_PRINT_TAB | JV_PRINT_INDENT_FLAGS(7));
437:         int indent = atoi(argv[i+1]);
438:         if (indent < -1 || indent > 7) {
439:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: --indent takes a number between -1 and 7\n", progname);
440:           die();
441:         }
442:         *dumpopts |= JV_PRINT_INDENT_FLAGS(indent);
443:         i++;
444:         continue;
445:       }
446:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "seq", &short_opts)) {
447:         *options |= SEQ;
448:         continue;
449:       }
450:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "stream", &short_opts)) {
451:         parser_opts->parser_flags |= JV_PARSE_STREAMING;
452:         continue;
453:       }
454:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "stream-errors", &short_opts)) {
455:         parser_opts->parser_flags |= JV_PARSE_STREAMING | JV_PARSE_STREAM_ERRORS;
456:         continue;
457:       }
458:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'e', "exit-status", &short_opts)) {
459:         *options |= EXIT_STATUS;
460:         if (!short_opts) continue;
461:       }
462:       // FIXME: For --arg* we should check that the varname is acceptable
463:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "args", &short_opts)) {
464:         mode->further_args_are_strings = 1;
465:         mode->further_args_are_json = 0;
466:         continue;
467:       }
468:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "jsonargs", &short_opts)) {
469:         mode->further_args_are_strings = 0;
470:         mode->further_args_are_json = 1;
471:         continue;
472:       }
473:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "arg", &short_opts)) {
474:         if (i >= argc - 2) {
475:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: --arg takes two parameters (e.g. --arg varname value)\n", progname);
476:           die();
477:         }
478:         if (!jv_object_has(jv_copy(*program_arguments), jv_string(argv[i+1])))
479:           *program_arguments = jv_object_set(*program_arguments, jv_string(argv[i+1]), jv_string(argv[i+2]));
480:         i += 2; // skip the next two arguments
481:         continue;
482:       }
483:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "argjson", &short_opts)) {
484:         if (i >= argc - 2) {
485:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: --argjson takes two parameters (e.g. --argjson varname text)\n", progname);
486:           die();
487:         }
488:         if (!jv_object_has(jv_copy(*program_arguments), jv_string(argv[i+1]))) {
489:           jv v = jv_parse(argv[i+2]);
490:           if (!jv_is_valid(v)) {
491:             fprintf(stderr, "%s: invalid JSON text passed to --argjson\n", progname);
492:             die();
493:           }
494:           *program_arguments = jv_object_set(*program_arguments, jv_string(argv[i+1]), v);
495:         }
496:         i += 2; // skip the next two arguments
497:         continue;
498:       }
499:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "rawfile", &short_opts) ||
500:           isoption(argv[i], 0, "slurpfile", &short_opts)) {
501:         int raw = isoption(argv[i], 0, "rawfile", &short_opts);
502:         const char *which;
503:         if (raw)
504:           which = "rawfile";
505:         else
506:           which = "slurpfile";
507:         if (i >= argc - 2) {
508:           fprintf(stderr, "%s: --%s takes two parameters (e.g. --%s varname filename)\n", progname, which, which);
509:           die();
510:         }
511:         if (!jv_object_has(jv_copy(*program_arguments), jv_string(argv[i+1]))) {
512:           jv data = jv_load_file(argv[i+2], raw);
513:           if (!jv_is_valid(data)) {
514:             data = jv_invalid_get_msg(data);
515:             fprintf(stderr, "%s: Bad JSON in --%s %s %s: %s\n", progname, which,
516:                     argv[i+1], argv[i+2], jv_string_value(data));
517:             jv_free(data);
518:             *ret = JQ_ERROR_SYSTEM;
519:             return 1;
520:           }
521:           *program_arguments = jv_object_set(*program_arguments, jv_string(argv[i+1]), data);
522:         }
523:         i += 2; // skip the next two arguments
524:         continue;
525:       }
526:       if (isoption(argv[i],  0,  "debug-dump-disasm", &short_opts)) {
527:         compile_opts->dump_disasm = 1;
528:         *options |= DUMP_DISASM;
529:         continue;
530:       }
531:       if (isoption(argv[i],  0,  "debug-trace=all", &short_opts)) {
532:         *jq_flags |= JQ_DEBUG_TRACE_ALL;
533:         if (!short_opts) continue;
534:       }
535:       if (isoption(argv[i],  0,  "debug-trace", &short_opts)) {
536:         *jq_flags |= JQ_DEBUG_TRACE;
537:         continue;
538:       }
539:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'h', "help", &short_opts)) {
540:         usage(0, 0);
541:         if (!short_opts) continue;
542:       }
543:       if (isoption(argv[i], 'V', "version", &short_opts)) {
544:         printf("jq-%s\n", JQ_VERSION);
545:         *ret = JQ_OK;
546:         return 1;
547:       }
548:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "build-configuration", &short_opts)) {
549:         printf("%s\n", JQ_CONFIG);
550:         *ret = JQ_OK;
551:         return 1;
552:       }
553:       if (isoption(argv[i], 0, "run-tests", &short_opts)) {
554:         i++;
555:         // XXX Pass program_arguments, even a whole jq_state *, through;
556:         // could be useful for testing
557:         *ret = jq_testsuite(*lib_search_paths,
558:                            compile_opts->dump_disasm || (*options & DUMP_DISASM) || (*jq_flags & JQ_DEBUG_TRACE),
559:                            argc - i, argv + i);
560:         return 1;
561:       }
562: 
563:       // check for unknown options... if this argument was a short option
564:       if (strlen(argv[i]) != short_opts + 1) {
565:         fprintf(stderr, "%s: Unknown option %s\n", progname, argv[i]);
566:         die();
567:       }
568:     }
569:   }
570:   return 0;
571: }
